_comment: Companion to decision_weighted_zero_weight.json at schema_version 1. Together the pair pins EXACTLY where the versions diverge on a zero-decisive-weight tally: the NEGATIVE direction is denied at every schema_version (the decline guard needs a decisive reject, and weight-0 votes are non-decisive at every version), while the POSITIVE direction is denied only under schema_version 3 and sealed under the preserved legacy arm. Neither fixture alone pins that split.
description: Decision Mode: schema_version 1 keeps the legacy fail-open positive path on a zero-weight tally.

policy.description: Weighted vote over a one-member electorate, initiator-only commitment, legacy schema_version 1 fail-open empty-tally semantics.

messages._comment: A weight-0 vote is NON-DECISIVE under 'weighted' at EVERY schema_version (RFC-MACP-0012 4.1, weighted electorate rule): it is accepted as a message and preserved in history, but contributes to neither side of the ratio, does not enter the decisive tally, and does not satisfy the decline guard of RFC-MACP-0007 6.2. 'agent://b' is a declared participant absent from the weights map, so its weight is 0.

VERSION-INVARIANT. The decline guard requires at least one DECISIVE explicit REJECT, and weight-0 non-decisiveness holds at every schema_version, so this is denied here exactly as it is under schema_version 3 (RFC-MACP-0012 4.1; RFC-MACP-0007 6.2). The negative direction does not diverge across versions.

payload.reason: negative commitment attempted with only a weight-0 REJECT on the tally

messages._comment: THE DIVERGENCE. Identical tally, identical decisive weight of zero -- but schema_version 1 applies the legacy fail-open rule: the algorithm produces no result, and with require_vote_quorum false the absence of decisive votes does not block a positive commitment, so it SEALS. The same message is DENIED under schema_version 3 (decision_weighted_zero_weight.json). Preserved for replay per RFC-MACP-0012 8, not endorsed.

payload.reason: positive commitment at zero total decisive weight under legacy semantics
